quotes.text: The world has not yet seen a major AI-driven cyber attack. On the scale of attacks like NotPetya or WannaCry, what is the likelihood that we see an attack on this scale or worse in the next 5 years?

Trump's own Department of Justice has warned that China is seeking to become the AI leader by 2030 and plans to use AI chips to modernize its military, design and test weapons of mass destruction, and deploy advanced surveillance tools.

You know, I remain deeply worried and concerned about President Trump's decision to allow export of advanced chips to China. [...] who can then use this technology to attack us? Who could use this technology to cyber attack our critical infrastructure?
